consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1978-08-30 show at Red Rocks features some standout performances, particularly of 'If I Had the World to Give' and 'Iko Iko'. While there are mixed feelings about the overall energy of the show, many appreciate the laid-back vibe and the unique setlist that includes several first-time performances.
standout_songs: If I Had the World to Give
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 35 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The show has notable highlights but is marred by inconsistent energy and performance quality, leading to a mixed reception among fans.
